prompt: Give the owner a read-only release review of the binder-inspect skill exported as binder.md. Read consumers.md and trace.md and assess the three intake tickets in tickets.md against those sources, not just against the ticket summaries. Use Change for a demonstrated defect, Verify for a decision-changing evidence gap, and Consider for a preference. Return bare JSON with ticket_ids (an object mapping change, verify, and consider to arrays of ticket IDs in intake order); conflicting_rules (array with the promise then the executable rule ID); affected_consumer (consumer ID); observed_effect (one of source-edit, output-create, output-read, no-effect); and conflict_evidence (one of static, live, unknown). Explain why each decision follows and what would resolve any gap in an additional rationale field. Do not edit or execute anything.
terse: Review the existing skill against its promised outcome and real consumers. Cite reproducible contradictions or failures, rank by consequence, identify gaps instead of inventing evidence, and leave the skill unchanged.
